caption:
Toto rolled his ankle on a weekend run, but the outside of his foot is sorer than the ankle itself.

Most rolled ankles settle well with gradual, guided movement rather than total rest. But if the bone on the outer foot is tender to press, or you can't take a few steps, it's worth getting checked first, as sometimes imaging is needed.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: ankle circles, 10 each way, then 10 calf raises once it's comfortable. Stop if pain gets worse.

Swelling hanging around past two weeks is worth an assessment too. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
